## Simpsons Dataset

-   Tidy Tuesday 2025-02-04

-   Original data set from Kaggle: <https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/prashant111/the-simpsons-dataset>

-   Dataset includes

    -   Characters

    -   Episodes

    -   Locations

    -   Script Lines

## Question 1{.smaller}

::::: columns
::: {.column width="30%"}
**How have the IMDB ratings of the Simpsons episodes changed over time?**

-   Audiences claim that the Simpsons was better when it first aired

<!-- -->

-   Must define Era variable first:

    -   Classic (Seasons 1-8)

    -   Scully (Seasons 9-12)

    -   Jean SD (Seasons 13-19)

    -   Jean HD (Seasons 20+)
:::

::: {.column width="70%"}
```{r, warning=FALSE, fig.width=5.5}
simpsons_episodes <- simpsons_episodes |>
  mutate(
    era = case_when(
      season >=1 & season <= 8 ~ "Classic (1-8)",
      season >= 9 & season <= 12 ~ "Scully (9-12)",
      season >= 13 & season <=19 ~ "Jean SD (13-19)",
      season >= 20 ~ "Jean HD (20+)"
    ),
    era = factor(era,levels = c("Classic (1-8)","Scully (9-12)","Jean SD (13-19)","Jean HD (20+)"))
  )

ggplot(simpsons_episodes, aes(x = era, y = imdb_rating, fill = era)) + 
  geom_boxplot(show.legend = FALSE) + # create box plot
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") + # set color scheme
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "IMDB Rating",
    title = "IMDB Ratings by Simpsons Era"
  ) + theme_minimal()
```
:::
:::::

## Question 1 Continued

```{r}
ggplot(simpsons_episodes, aes(x = season, y = imdb_rating)) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = era)) + # create scatter plot
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black", se = FALSE) + # plot straight trend line
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 35, by = 5)) + 
  scale_color_brewer(name = "Era", palette = "Set2") + # set same color scheme
  labs(
    x = "Season",
    y = "IMDB Rating",
    title = "IMDB Ratings across Seasons of the Simpsons"
  ) + theme_minimal()
```

## Question 2{.smaller}

::::: columns
::: {.column width="30%"}
**Which Simpsons characters have the most speaking lines during each era of the show, and how does this change over time?**

-   Decided to work in Percentage of Lines for each season/era per character

-   Audiences claim side characters have taken a step back in more recent seasons, with Homer having most of the lines
:::

::: {.column width="70%"}
```{r, warning=FALSE, fig.width=5.5}
lines_by_season <- simpsons_script_lines |>
  left_join(
    simpsons_episodes |> select(id, season, era),
    by = c("episode_id" = "id")
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(season), !is.na(raw_character_text))

top10_characters <- lines_by_season |>
  count(raw_character_text, sort = TRUE) |>
  slice_head(n = 10) |>
  pull(raw_character_text)

season_percent <- lines_by_season |>
  count(season, raw_character_text, name = "line_amount") |>
  group_by(season) |>
  mutate(pct_lines = line_amount / sum(line_amount) * 100) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(raw_character_text %in% top10_characters) |>
  mutate(raw_character_text = factor(raw_character_text, levels = rev(top10_characters)))

era_percent <- lines_by_season |>
  count(era, raw_character_text, name = "line_amount") |>
  group_by(era) |>
  mutate(pct_lines = line_amount / sum(line_amount) * 100) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(raw_character_text %in% top10_characters) |>
  mutate(raw_character_text = factor(raw_character_text, levels = rev(top10_characters)))

ggplot(season_percent, aes(x = season, y = pct_lines, fill = raw_character_text)) + 
  geom_col() + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 35, by = 5)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1)) + 
  scale_fill_brewer(name = "Character", palette = "Set3") +
  labs(
    x = "Season",
    y = "Line Percentage",
    title = "Simpsons Top 10 Characters by Line Amounts per Season"
  ) + theme_minimal()
```
:::
:::::

## Question 2 Continued

```{r, warning=FALSE, fig.width=8}
ggplot(era_percent, aes(x = era, y = raw_character_text, fill = pct_lines)) + 
  geom_tile() + 
  scale_fill_distiller(name = "Line Percentage", palette = "Greens", direction = 1, labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1)) + 
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(round(pct_lines, 1), "%"),
        color = pct_lines > max(pct_lines) * 0.6),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) + scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "white")) + 
  labs(
    x = "Era",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Heat Map of Character Dialogue by Simpsons Era"
  ) + theme_minimal()
```
